items.question: Trong câu "A computer is an electronic device capable of receiving input data, processing that data according to programmed instructions, and producing output.", từ "electronic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A computer is an electronic device capable of receiving input data, processing that data according to programmed instructions, and producing output.", what does "electronic" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: working by means of electric circuits
items.explanation: electronic /ɪˌlekˈtrɒn.ɪk/ (tính từ): (thuộc) điện tử. "An electronic device" = một thiết bị điện tử; danh từ liên quan: electronics (ngành/đồ điện tử).
items.explanationEn: electronic /ɪˌlekˈtrɒn.ɪk/ (adjective): working by means of electric circuits. "An electronic device" is a machine powered by circuits; related noun: electronics.

items.question: Trong câu "A computer is an electronic device capable of receiving input data, processing that data according to programmed instructions, and producing output.", từ "device" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A computer is an electronic device capable of receiving input data, processing that data according to programmed instructions, and producing output.", what does "device" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a machine built for a purpose
items.explanation: device /dɪˈvaɪs/ (danh từ): thiết bị. Hay gặp trong "mobile device" (thiết bị di động), "input device" (thiết bị nhập).
items.explanationEn: device /dɪˈvaɪs/ (noun): a machine built for a purpose. Common in "mobile device" and "input device".

items.question: Trong câu "A computer is an electronic device capable of receiving input data, processing that data according to programmed instructions, and producing output.", từ "capable of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A computer is an electronic device capable of receiving input data, processing that data according to programmed instructions, and producing output.", what does "capable of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: capable of /ˈkeɪ.pə.bəl əv/ (cụm từ): có khả năng (làm gì). Theo sau "capable of" là danh động từ (V-ing): capable of receiving data.
items.explanationEn: capable of /ˈkeɪ.pə.bəl əv/ (phrase): able to do something. It is followed by a gerund (-ing form): capable of receiving data.

items.question: Trong câu "A computer is an electronic device capable of receiving input data, processing that data according to programmed instructions, and producing output.", từ "receive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A computer is an electronic device capable of receiving input data, processing that data according to programmed instructions, and producing output.", what does "receive" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to get something sent to you
items.explanation: receive /rɪˈsiːv/ (động từ): nhận. "Receive input" = nhận dữ liệu vào; danh từ: receiver (bộ/người nhận).
items.explanationEn: receive /rɪˈsiːv/ (verb): to get something sent to you. "Receive input" means taking data in; noun: receiver.

items.question: Trong câu "A computer is an electronic device capable of receiving input data, processing that data according to programmed instructions, and producing output.", từ "according to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A computer is an electronic device capable of receiving input data, processing that data according to programmed instructions, and producing output.", what does "according to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: according to /əˈkɔː.dɪŋ tuː/ (cụm từ): theo, dựa theo. "According to the instructions" = làm theo chỉ dẫn; cũng dùng để trích nguồn: according to the docs.
items.explanationEn: according to /əˈkɔː.dɪŋ tuː/ (phrase): as stated or set by. "According to the instructions" means following them; also used to cite a source: according to the docs.

items.question: Trong câu "A computer is an electronic device capable of receiving input data, processing that data according to programmed instructions, and producing output.", từ "instruction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A computer is an electronic device capable of receiving input data, processing that data according to programmed instructions, and producing output.", what does "instruction" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a command telling it what to do
items.explanation: instruction /ɪnˈstrʌk.ʃən/ (danh từ): lệnh, chỉ thị (cho máy). Trong máy tính, "program instructions" là các lệnh CPU thực thi; "instructions" (số nhiều) còn là hướng dẫn sử dụng.
items.explanationEn: instruction /ɪnˈstrʌk.ʃən/ (noun): a command telling it what to do. In computing, "program instructions" are commands the CPU runs; plural "instructions" can also mean directions for use.

items.question: Trong câu "A computer is an electronic device capable of receiving input data, processing that data according to programmed instructions, and producing output.", từ "produce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A computer is an electronic device capable of receiving input data, processing that data according to programmed instructions, and producing output.", what does "produce" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make or create a result
items.explanation: produce /prəˈdjuːs/ (động từ): tạo ra. "Produce output" = tạo ra kết quả đầu ra; danh từ: product, production.
items.explanationEn: produce /prəˈdjuːs/ (verb): to make or create a result. "Produce output" means creating results; nouns: product, production.

items.question: Trong câu "A computer operates based on two core components: hardware and software.", từ "operate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A computer operates based on two core components: hardware and software.", what does "operate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: operate /ˈɒp.ər.eɪt/ (động từ): hoạt động, vận hành. "Operate based on" = hoạt động dựa trên; danh từ: operation, operating system.
items.explanationEn: operate /ˈɒp.ər.eɪt/ (verb): to work or function. "Operate based on" means to function using something; nouns: operation, operating system.

items.question: Trong câu "A computer operates based on two core components: hardware and software.", từ "based on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A computer operates based on two core components: hardware and software.", what does "based on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: based on /beɪst ɒn/ (cụm từ): dựa trên. "Based on" chỉ nền tảng/căn cứ: decisions based on data (quyết định dựa trên dữ liệu).
items.explanationEn: based on /beɪst ɒn/ (phrase): using something as the foundation. "Based on" shows the foundation: decisions based on data.

items.question: Trong câu "A computer operates based on two core components: hardware and software.", từ "core" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A computer operates based on two core components: hardware and software.", what does "core" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: core /kɔːr/ (tính từ): cốt lõi, chủ chốt. "Core components" = các thành phần cốt lõi; danh từ "core" còn là lõi CPU (quad-core).
items.explanationEn: core /kɔːr/ (adjective): most central and important. "Core components" are the central parts; as a noun, "core" also means a CPU core (quad-core).

items.question: Trong câu "A computer operates based on two core components: hardware and software.", từ "component" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A computer operates based on two core components: hardware and software.", what does "component" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: one part of a larger whole
items.explanation: component /kəmˈpəʊ.nənt/ (danh từ): thành phần, bộ phận. "Hardware components" = các bộ phận phần cứng; trong lập trình còn chỉ "component" giao diện.
items.explanationEn: component /kəmˈpəʊ.nənt/ (noun): one part of a larger whole. "Hardware components" are physical parts; in programming it can also mean a UI component.

items.question: Trong câu "Hardware refers to all of the physical components you can see and touch.", từ "refer to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hardware refers to all of the physical components you can see and touch.", what does "refer to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: refer to /rɪˈfɜːr tuː/ (cụm từ): chỉ, dùng để nói đến. "X refers to Y" là mẫu câu định nghĩa rất phổ biến trong tài liệu kỹ thuật.
items.explanationEn: refer to /rɪˈfɜːr tuː/ (phrase): to mean or describe. "X refers to Y" is a very common defining pattern in technical docs.

items.question: Trong câu "Hardware refers to all of the physical components you can see and touch.", từ "physical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hardware refers to all of the physical components you can see and touch.", what does "physical" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: real and able to be touched
items.explanation: physical /ˈfɪz.ɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): vật lý, hữu hình. Trái nghĩa trong IT: virtual (ảo); ví dụ physical server vs virtual machine.
items.explanationEn: physical /ˈfɪz.ɪ.kəl/ (adjective): real and able to be touched. Its IT opposite is virtual: physical server vs virtual machine.

items.question: Trong câu "It executes program instructions, performs calculations, and coordinates the activity of the other components.", từ "execute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It executes program instructions, performs calculations, and coordinates the activity of the other components.", what does "execute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: execute /ˈek.sɪ.kjuːt/ (động từ): thực thi, chạy. "Execute instructions/code" = thực thi lệnh/mã; danh từ: execution.
items.explanationEn: execute /ˈek.sɪ.kjuːt/ (verb): to carry out a command. "Execute instructions/code" means running them; noun: execution.

items.question: Trong câu "It executes program instructions, performs calculations, and coordinates the activity of the other components.", từ "perform" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It executes program instructions, performs calculations, and coordinates the activity of the other components.", what does "perform" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to act or play on stage
to do a task or action
items.explanation: perform /pəˈfɔːm/ (động từ): thực hiện. "Perform calculations/tasks" = thực hiện phép tính/công việc; danh từ: performance (hiệu năng).
items.explanationEn: perform /pəˈfɔːm/ (verb): to do a task or action. "Perform calculations/tasks" means doing them; noun: performance.

items.question: Trong câu "It executes program instructions, performs calculations, and coordinates the activity of the other components.", từ "calculation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It executes program instructions, performs calculations, and coordinates the activity of the other components.", what does "calculation" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: working out a number with maths
items.explanation: calculation /ˌkæl.kjəˈleɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): phép tính. "Perform calculations" = thực hiện phép tính; động từ: calculate.
items.explanationEn: calculation /ˌkæl.kjəˈleɪ.ʃən/ (noun): working out a number with maths. "Perform calculations" means doing maths; verb: calculate.

items.question: Trong câu "It executes program instructions, performs calculations, and coordinates the activity of the other components.", từ "coordinate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It executes program instructions, performs calculations, and coordinates the activity of the other components.", what does "coordinate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to organise parts to work together
items.explanation: coordinate /kəʊˈɔː.dɪ.neɪt/ (động từ): điều phối. "Coordinate the activity" = điều phối hoạt động; danh từ: coordination; "coordinates" (danh từ) còn là tọa độ.
items.explanationEn: coordinate /kəʊˈɔː.dɪ.neɪt/ (verb): to organise parts to work together. "Coordinate the activity" means organising it; noun: coordination; the noun "coordinates" also means map position.

items.question: Trong câu "It executes program instructions, performs calculations, and coordinates the activity of the other components.", từ "activity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It executes program instructions, performs calculations, and coordinates the activity of the other components.", what does "activity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: activity /ækˈtɪv.ə.ti/ (danh từ): hoạt động. "Network/CPU activity" = hoạt động mạng/CPU; tính từ: active.
items.explanationEn: activity /ækˈtɪv.ə.ti/ (noun): the work something is doing. "Network/CPU activity" is the work being done; adjective: active.

items.question: Trong câu "CPU speed is measured in GHz (gigahertz) — billions of processing cycles per second.", từ "measure" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CPU speed is measured in GHz (gigahertz) — billions of processing cycles per second.", what does "measure" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to find the size or amount
items.explanation: measure /ˈmeʒ.ər/ (động từ): đo (lường). "Be measured in" + đơn vị: speed is measured in GHz; danh từ: measurement.
items.explanationEn: measure /ˈmeʒ.ər/ (verb): to find the size or amount. "Be measured in" + unit: speed is measured in GHz; noun: measurement.

items.question: Trong câu "CPU speed is measured in GHz (gigahertz) — billions of processing cycles per second.", từ "cycle" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CPU speed is measured in GHz (gigahertz) — billions of processing cycles per second.", what does "cycle" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: cycle /ˈsaɪ.kəl/ (danh từ): chu kỳ. "Processing cycles per second" = số chu kỳ xử lý mỗi giây; cũng gặp trong "life cycle" (vòng đời).
items.explanationEn: cycle /ˈsaɪ.kəl/ (noun): one repeated round of events. "Processing cycles per second" counts repeated rounds; also found in "life cycle".

items.question: Trong câu "Modern CPUs have multiple cores: quad-core (4 cores), octa-core (8 cores), and so on.", từ "multiple" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Modern CPUs have multiple cores: quad-core (4 cores), octa-core (8 cores), and so on.", what does "multiple" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: multiple /ˈmʌl.tɪ.pəl/ (tính từ): nhiều. "Multiple cores" = nhiều lõi; danh từ "multiple" trong toán là bội số.
items.explanationEn: multiple /ˈmʌl.tɪ.pəl/ (adjective): more than one. "Multiple cores" means several cores; the noun "multiple" in maths is a product of a number.

items.question: Trong câu "Modern CPUs have multiple cores: quad-core (4 cores), octa-core (8 cores), and so on.", từ "and so on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Modern CPUs have multiple cores: quad-core (4 cores), octa-core (8 cores), and so on.", what does "and so on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: and so on /ənd ˈsəʊ ɒn/ (cụm từ): vân vân. "And so on" đặt cuối một danh sách ví dụ, tương đương "etc."
items.explanationEn: and so on /ənd ˈsəʊ ɒn/ (phrase): and other similar things. "And so on" ends a list of examples, like "etc."

items.question: Trong câu "RAM (Random Access Memory) is temporary memory that stores the data and programs currently running.", từ "temporary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "RAM (Random Access Memory) is temporary memory that stores the data and programs currently running.", what does "temporary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: temporary /ˈtem.pər.ər.i/ (tính từ): tạm thời. "Temporary memory" = bộ nhớ tạm; trái nghĩa: permanent; "temp file" là viết tắt của temporary file.
items.explanationEn: temporary /ˈtem.pər.ər.i/ (adjective): lasting only a short time. "Temporary memory" is short-term; opposite: permanent; "temp file" is short for temporary file.

items.question: Trong câu "RAM (Random Access Memory) is temporary memory that stores the data and programs currently running.", từ "currently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "RAM (Random Access Memory) is temporary memory that stores the data and programs currently running.", what does "currently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: currently /ˈkʌr.ənt.li/ (trạng từ): hiện đang. "Programs currently running" = các chương trình đang chạy; tính từ: current.
items.explanationEn: currently /ˈkʌr.ənt.li/ (adverb): at the present time. "Programs currently running" are the ones running now; adjective: current.

items.question: Trong câu "When the machine is turned off, all data in RAM is erased.", từ "turn off" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When the machine is turned off, all data in RAM is erased.", what does "turn off" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: turn off /tɜːn ˈɒf/ (cụm từ): tắt (máy). "Turn off" ≈ switch off / shut down; trái nghĩa: turn on.
items.explanationEn: turn off /tɜːn ˈɒf/ (phrase): to stop a machine working. "Turn off" is like switch off or shut down; opposite: turn on.

items.question: Trong câu "When the machine is turned off, all data in RAM is erased.", từ "erase" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When the machine is turned off, all data in RAM is erased.", what does "erase" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: erase /ɪˈreɪz/ (động từ): xóa sạch. "Data is erased" = dữ liệu bị xóa; gần nghĩa: delete, wipe.
items.explanationEn: erase /ɪˈreɪz/ (verb): to remove completely. "Data is erased" means it is removed; similar: delete, wipe.

items.question: Trong câu "Consumer computers typically have 8–32 GB of RAM.", từ "consumer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Consumer computers typically have 8–32 GB of RAM.", what does "consumer" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an ordinary person who buys products
items.explanation: consumer /kənˈsjuː.mər/ (danh từ): người tiêu dùng. "Consumer computers" = máy tính cho người dùng phổ thông (khác với máy chủ doanh nghiệp).
items.explanationEn: consumer /kənˈsjuː.mər/ (noun): an ordinary person who buys products. "Consumer computers" are ordinary personal machines, not enterprise servers.

items.question: Trong câu "Consumer computers typically have 8–32 GB of RAM.", từ "typically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Consumer computers typically have 8–32 GB of RAM.", what does "typically" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: typically /ˈtɪp.ɪ.kəl.i/ (trạng từ): thông thường. "Typically" dùng khi nêu con số điển hình; tính từ: typical.
items.explanationEn: typically /ˈtɪp.ɪ.kəl.i/ (adverb): in most normal cases. "Typically" introduces a normal or usual figure; adjective: typical.

items.question: Trong câu "More RAM → the machine can run more applications at once without slowing down.", từ "at once" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "More RAM → the machine can run more applications at once without slowing down.", what does "at once" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at once /ət ˈwʌns/ (cụm từ): cùng một lúc. "At once" có hai nghĩa: "cùng lúc" (như trong câu này) và "ngay lập tức".
items.explanationEn: at once /ət ˈwʌns/ (phrase): at the same time. "At once" has two senses: "at the same time" (as here) and "immediately".

items.question: Trong câu "More RAM → the machine can run more applications at once without slowing down.", từ "slow down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "More RAM → the machine can run more applications at once without slowing down.", what does "slow down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: slow down /sləʊ ˈdaʊn/ (cụm từ): chạy chậm lại. "Without slowing down" = mà không bị chậm đi; danh từ: slowdown.
items.explanationEn: slow down /sləʊ ˈdaʊn/ (phrase): to become less fast. "Without slowing down" means keeping the same speed; noun: slowdown.

items.question: Trong câu "Example: Opening Chrome with 20 tabs consumes roughly 2–4 GB of RAM.", từ "consume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Example: Opening Chrome with 20 tabs consumes roughly 2–4 GB of RAM.", what does "consume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ (động từ): tiêu tốn, sử dụng hết. "Consume memory/CPU" = tiêu tốn bộ nhớ/CPU; danh từ: consumption.
items.explanationEn: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ (verb): to use up a resource. "Consume memory/CPU" means using it up; noun: consumption.

items.question: Trong câu "Example: Opening Chrome with 20 tabs consumes roughly 2–4 GB of RAM.", từ "roughly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Example: Opening Chrome with 20 tabs consumes roughly 2–4 GB of RAM.", what does "roughly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: roughly /ˈrʌf.li/ (trạng từ): khoảng, xấp xỉ. "Roughly 2–4 GB" = khoảng 2–4 GB; gần nghĩa: approximately, about.
items.explanationEn: roughly /ˈrʌf.li/ (adverb): about, not exactly. "Roughly 2–4 GB" means about that much; similar: approximately.

items.question: Trong câu "Storage keeps data permanently (even when the machine is turned off).", từ "permanently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Storage keeps data permanently (even when the machine is turned off).", what does "permanently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: permanently /ˈpɜː.mə.nənt.li/ (trạng từ): lâu dài, vĩnh viễn. "Keep data permanently" = lưu dữ liệu lâu dài; tính từ: permanent; trái nghĩa: temporarily.
items.explanationEn: permanently /ˈpɜː.mə.nənt.li/ (adverb): for all time, not temporarily. "Keep data permanently" means it survives power-off; adjective: permanent; opposite: temporarily.

items.question: Trong câu "The circuit board that connects all the components together: CPU, RAM, storage, graphics card, and more.", từ "circuit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The circuit board that connects all the components together: CPU, RAM, storage, graphics card, and more.", what does "circuit" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a path that electricity flows around
items.explanation: circuit /ˈsɜː.kɪt/ (danh từ): mạch điện. "Circuit board" = bảng mạch; "short circuit" = đoản mạch.
items.explanationEn: circuit /ˈsɜː.kɪt/ (noun): a path that electricity flows around. "Circuit board" is a board of electrical paths; "short circuit" is a wiring fault.

items.question: Trong câu "The circuit board that connects all the components together: CPU, RAM, storage, graphics card, and more.", từ "connect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The circuit board that connects all the components together: CPU, RAM, storage, graphics card, and more.", what does "connect" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to link ideas in the mind
items.explanation: connect /kəˈnekt/ (động từ): kết nối. "Connect A to B" hoặc "connect ... together"; danh từ: connection.
items.explanationEn: connect /kəˈnekt/ (verb): to join things together. Use "connect A to B" or "connect ... together"; noun: connection.

items.question: Trong câu "Handles image and video processing.", từ "handle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Handles image and video processing.", what does "handle" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to deal with or take care of
items.explanation: handle /ˈhæn.dəl/ (động từ): xử lý, đảm nhận. "Handle requests/errors" = xử lý yêu cầu/lỗi; danh từ "handle" là tay cầm.
items.explanationEn: handle /ˈhæn.dəl/ (verb): to deal with or take care of. "Handle requests/errors" means dealing with them; the noun "handle" is the part you hold.

items.question: Trong câu "An integrated GPU is built into the CPU (Intel HD Graphics); a discrete GPU (NVIDIA, AMD) is used for heavy graphics work, gaming, and AI.", từ "integrated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An integrated GPU is built into the CPU (Intel HD Graphics); a discrete GPU (NVIDIA, AMD) is used for heavy graphics work, gaming, and AI.", what does "integrated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: integrated /ˈɪn.tɪ.ɡreɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): tích hợp sẵn. "Integrated GPU" = GPU tích hợp; động từ: integrate; danh từ: integration.
items.explanationEn: integrated /ˈɪn.tɪ.ɡreɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): combined into another part. "Integrated GPU" is part of the CPU chip; verb: integrate; noun: integration.

items.question: Trong câu "An integrated GPU is built into the CPU (Intel HD Graphics); a discrete GPU (NVIDIA, AMD) is used for heavy graphics work, gaming, and AI.", từ "build into" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An integrated GPU is built into the CPU (Intel HD Graphics); a discrete GPU (NVIDIA, AMD) is used for heavy graphics work, gaming, and AI.", what does "build into" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: build into /bɪld ˈɪn.tuː/ (cụm từ): gắn sẵn vào. "Be built into" = được gắn sẵn trong; tính từ: built-in (có sẵn).
items.explanationEn: build into /bɪld ˈɪn.tuː/ (phrase): to make part of something. "Be built into" means included inside; adjective: built-in.

items.question: Trong câu "An integrated GPU is built into the CPU (Intel HD Graphics); a discrete GPU (NVIDIA, AMD) is used for heavy graphics work, gaming, and AI.", từ "discrete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An integrated GPU is built into the CPU (Intel HD Graphics); a discrete GPU (NVIDIA, AMD) is used for heavy graphics work, gaming, and AI.", what does "discrete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: discrete /dɪˈskriːt/ (tính từ): rời, riêng biệt. "Discrete GPU" = card đồ họa rời; đừng nhầm với "discreet" (kín đáo) phát âm giống hệt.
items.explanationEn: discrete /dɪˈskriːt/ (adjective): separate and distinct. "Discrete GPU" is a separate card; don't confuse it with "discreet" (careful), which sounds the same.

items.question: Trong câu "An integrated GPU is built into the CPU (Intel HD Graphics); a discrete GPU (NVIDIA, AMD) is used for heavy graphics work, gaming, and AI.", từ "heavy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An integrated GPU is built into the CPU (Intel HD Graphics); a discrete GPU (NVIDIA, AMD) is used for heavy graphics work, gaming, and AI.", what does "heavy" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: needing a lot of effort or power
items.explanation: heavy /ˈhev.i/ (tính từ): nặng, đòi hỏi nhiều. "Heavy graphics work" = công việc đồ họa nặng; cũng gặp "heavy load", "heavy traffic".
items.explanationEn: heavy /ˈhev.i/ (adjective): needing a lot of effort or power. "Heavy graphics work" demands a lot of power; also "heavy load", "heavy traffic".

items.question: Trong câu "Software is the collection of programs (code) that control the hardware and carry out tasks.", từ "collection" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Software is the collection of programs (code) that control the hardware and carry out tasks.", what does "collection" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: collection /kəˈlek.ʃən/ (danh từ): tập hợp. "A collection of programs" = tập hợp các chương trình; động từ: collect.
items.explanationEn: collection /kəˈlek.ʃən/ (noun): a group of things together. "A collection of programs" is a group of them; verb: collect.

items.question: Trong câu "Software is the collection of programs (code) that control the hardware and carry out tasks.", từ "carry out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Software is the collection of programs (code) that control the hardware and carry out tasks.", what does "carry out" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to do or complete a task
items.explanation: carry out /ˈkær.i aʊt/ (cụm từ): thực hiện. "Carry out tasks/tests" = thực hiện công việc/kiểm thử; gần nghĩa: perform.
items.explanationEn: carry out /ˈkær.i aʊt/ (phrase): to do or complete a task. "Carry out tasks/tests" means doing them; similar: perform.

items.question: Trong câu "Software is the collection of programs (code) that control the hardware and carry out tasks.", từ "task" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Software is the collection of programs (code) that control the hardware and carry out tasks.", what does "task" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a piece of work to do
items.explanation: task /tɑːsk/ (danh từ): công việc, tác vụ. "Carry out tasks" = thực hiện tác vụ; "Task Manager" = trình quản lý tác vụ.
items.explanationEn: task /tɑːsk/ (noun): a piece of work to do. "Carry out tasks" means doing work; "Task Manager" lists running work.

items.question: Trong câu "The foundational software that manages all of the computer's resources and provides the environment for running other software.", từ "foundational" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The foundational software that manages all of the computer's resources and provides the environment for running other software.", what does "foundational" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: foundational /faʊnˈdeɪ.ʃən.əl/ (tính từ): nền tảng, cơ bản. "Foundational software" = phần mềm nền tảng; danh từ: foundation (nền móng; quỹ).
items.explanationEn: foundational /faʊnˈdeɪ.ʃən.əl/ (adjective): forming the base for others. "Foundational software" is the base layer; noun: foundation (base; also a charity).

items.question: Trong câu "The foundational software that manages all of the computer's resources and provides the environment for running other software.", từ "manage" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The foundational software that manages all of the computer's resources and provides the environment for running other software.", what does "manage" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: manage /ˈmæn.ɪdʒ/ (động từ): quản lý. "Manage resources" = quản lý tài nguyên; "manage to do" lại có nghĩa là xoay xở làm được.
items.explanationEn: manage /ˈmæn.ɪdʒ/ (verb): to control and organise. "Manage resources" means controlling them; "manage to do" means succeeding in doing.

items.question: Trong câu "The foundational software that manages all of the computer's resources and provides the environment for running other software.", từ "resource" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The foundational software that manages all of the computer's resources and provides the environment for running other software.", what does "resource" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a supply that can be used
items.explanation: resource /rɪˈzɔːs/ (danh từ): tài nguyên. "System resources" = tài nguyên hệ thống (CPU, RAM, ổ đĩa); "learning resources" = tài liệu học.
items.explanationEn: resource /rɪˈzɔːs/ (noun): a supply that can be used. "System resources" are CPU, RAM and disk; "learning resources" are study materials.

items.question: Trong câu "The foundational software that manages all of the computer's resources and provides the environment for running other software.", từ "provide" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The foundational software that manages all of the computer's resources and provides the environment for running other software.", what does "provide" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: provide /prəˈvaɪd/ (động từ): cung cấp. "Provide something for/to someone"; danh từ: provider (nhà cung cấp).
items.explanationEn: provide /prəˈvaɪd/ (verb): to give or make available. Use "provide something for/to someone"; noun: provider.

items.question: Trong câu "The foundational software that manages all of the computer's resources and provides the environment for running other software.", từ "environment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The foundational software that manages all of the computer's resources and provides the environment for running other software.", what does "environment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: environment /ɪnˈvaɪ.rən.mənt/ (danh từ): môi trường (chạy). "Runtime/development environment" = môi trường chạy/phát triển.
items.explanationEn: environment /ɪnˈvaɪ.rən.mənt/ (noun): the setting where something runs. Common in "runtime environment" and "development environment".

items.question: Trong câu "Linux – open source, popular on servers.", từ "popular" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Linux – open source, popular on servers.", what does "popular" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: popular /ˈpɒp.jə.lər/ (tính từ): phổ biến. "Popular on servers" = phổ biến trên máy chủ; danh từ: popularity.
items.explanationEn: popular /ˈpɒp.jə.lər/ (adjective): used or liked by many. "Popular on servers" means widely used there; noun: popularity.

items.question: Trong câu "Linux – open source, popular on servers.", từ "open source" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Linux – open source, popular on servers.", what does "open source" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: with code free to view and change
free to try for a while
items.explanation: open source /ˌəʊ.pən ˈsɔːs/ (cụm từ): mã nguồn mở. "Open-source software" (có gạch nối khi đứng trước danh từ) = phần mềm mã nguồn mở.
items.explanationEn: open source /ˌəʊ.pən ˈsɔːs/ (phrase): with code free to view and change. Write "open-source software" (hyphenated) before a noun.

items.question: Trong câu "Programs that serve specific needs: Microsoft Word, Chrome, Photoshop, Spotify, and so on.", từ "serve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Programs that serve specific needs: Microsoft Word, Chrome, Photoshop, Spotify, and so on.", what does "serve" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put food on a table
to meet a need or purpose
items.explanation: serve /sɜːv/ (động từ): đáp ứng, phục vụ. "Serve a need/purpose" = đáp ứng nhu cầu/mục đích; danh từ liên quan: server (máy chủ).
items.explanationEn: serve /sɜːv/ (verb): to meet a need or purpose. "Serve a need/purpose" means meeting it; related noun: server.

items.question: Trong câu "Programs that serve specific needs: Microsoft Word, Chrome, Photoshop, Spotify, and so on.", từ "specific" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Programs that serve specific needs: Microsoft Word, Chrome, Photoshop, Spotify, and so on.", what does "specific" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: specific /spəˈsɪf.ɪk/ (tính từ): cụ thể, riêng biệt. "Specific needs" = nhu cầu cụ thể; trạng từ: specifically; động từ: specify.
items.explanationEn: specific /spəˈsɪf.ɪk/ (adjective): particular, clearly defined. "Specific needs" are particular ones; adverb: specifically; verb: specify.

items.question: Trong câu "Programs that support the operation of the operating system: device drivers, system utilities, and the like.", từ "support" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Programs that support the operation of the operating system: device drivers, system utilities, and the like.", what does "support" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to hold up the weight of
items.explanation: support /səˈpɔːt/ (động từ): hỗ trợ. "Support the operation" = hỗ trợ hoạt động; "does it support Linux?" = có tương thích với Linux không?
items.explanationEn: support /səˈpɔːt/ (verb): to help something work. "Support the operation" means helping it run; "Does it support Linux?" asks about compatibility.

items.question: Trong câu "Programs that support the operation of the operating system: device drivers, system utilities, and the like.", từ "operation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Programs that support the operation of the operating system: device drivers, system utilities, and the like.", what does "operation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: operation /ˌɒp.ərˈeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự vận hành. "The operation of the OS" = sự vận hành của hệ điều hành; trong toán "operation" là phép toán.
items.explanationEn: operation /ˌɒp.ərˈeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): the way something works. "The operation of the OS" is how it runs; in maths an "operation" is like addition.

items.question: Trong câu "Programs that support the operation of the operating system: device drivers, system utilities, and the like.", từ "utility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Programs that support the operation of the operating system: device drivers, system utilities, and the like.", what does "utility" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: utility /juːˈtɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): tiện ích (phần mềm). "System utilities" = tiện ích hệ thống (dọn đĩa, sao lưu...); "utility bill" = hóa đơn điện nước.
items.explanationEn: utility /juːˈtɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): a small helper program. "System utilities" are helper tools (disk cleanup, backup); a "utility bill" is for water or power.

items.question: Trong câu "Programs that support the operation of the operating system: device drivers, system utilities, and the like.", từ "and the like" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Programs that support the operation of the operating system: device drivers, system utilities, and the like.", what does "and the like" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: and the like /ənd ðə ˈlaɪk/ (cụm từ): và những thứ tương tự. "And the like" đặt cuối danh sách, gần nghĩa "and so on", "etc."
items.explanationEn: and the like /ənd ðə ˈlaɪk/ (phrase): and similar things. "And the like" closes a list, similar to "and so on" or "etc."

items.question: Trong câu "You press a key → the keyboard sends a signal to the CPU.", từ "press" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You press a key → the keyboard sends a signal to the CPU.", what does "press" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to push a button or key
items.explanation: press /pres/ (động từ): nhấn, bấm. "Press a key/button" = nhấn phím/nút; danh từ "the press" = báo chí.
items.explanationEn: press /pres/ (verb): to push a button or key. "Press a key/button" means pushing it; the noun "the press" means newspapers.

items.question: Trong câu "You press a key → the keyboard sends a signal to the CPU.", từ "signal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You press a key → the keyboard sends a signal to the CPU.", what does "signal" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: signal /ˈsɪɡ.nəl/ (danh từ): tín hiệu. "Send a signal to" = gửi tín hiệu đến; "Wi-Fi signal" = sóng Wi-Fi.
items.explanationEn: signal /ˈsɪɡ.nəl/ (noun): an electrical message sent on. "Send a signal to" means passing a message on; "Wi-Fi signal" is wireless strength.

items.question: Trong câu "The CPU looks up instructions in RAM (the running program).", từ "look up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The CPU looks up instructions in RAM (the running program).", what does "look up" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: look up /lʊk ˈʌp/ (cụm từ): tra cứu, tìm. "Look up a word/value" = tra từ/giá trị; danh từ: lookup (DNS lookup).
items.explanationEn: look up /lʊk ˈʌp/ (phrase): to search for information. "Look up a word/value" means finding it; noun: lookup (DNS lookup).

items.question: Trong câu "The CPU processes them and sends the result to the screen.", từ "result" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The CPU processes them and sends the result to the screen.", what does "result" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: what comes out of a process
items.explanation: result /rɪˈzʌlt/ (danh từ): kết quả. "Send the result to the screen" = đưa kết quả ra màn hình; "as a result" = kết quả là.
items.explanationEn: result /rɪˈzʌlt/ (noun): what comes out of a process. "Send the result to the screen" means showing the outcome; "as a result" means consequently.

items.question: Trong câu "The CPU processes them and sends the result to the screen.", từ "process" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The CPU processes them and sends the result to the screen.", what does "process" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to work on data to get output
items.explanation: process /ˈprəʊ.ses/ (động từ): xử lý. "Process data/requests" = xử lý dữ liệu/yêu cầu; danh từ: processor (bộ xử lý).
items.explanationEn: process /ˈprəʊ.ses/ (verb): to work on data to get output. "Process data/requests" means working on them; noun: processor.

items.question: Trong câu "If it needs to be saved → it is written to storage.", từ "save" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If it needs to be saved → it is written to storage.", what does "save" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: save /seɪv/ (động từ): lưu (tệp). "Save a file" = lưu tệp; "save time/money" = tiết kiệm thời gian/tiền.
items.explanationEn: save /seɪv/ (verb): to store data for later. "Save a file" stores it; "save time/money" means using less.

items.question: Trong câu "RAM: temporary memory – holds what is currently in use.", từ "hold" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "RAM: temporary memory – holds what is currently in use.", what does "hold" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: hold /həʊld/ (động từ): chứa, giữ. "Hold data" = chứa dữ liệu; "hold on" = chờ một chút.
items.explanationEn: hold /həʊld/ (verb): to keep or contain. "Hold data" means containing it; "hold on" means wait a moment.

items.question: Trong câu "RAM: temporary memory – holds what is currently in use.", từ "in use" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "RAM: temporary memory – holds what is currently in use.", what does "in use" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in use /ɪn ˈjuːs/ (cụm từ): đang được dùng. "Port already in use" = cổng đã bị chiếm dụng; trái nghĩa: not in use / unused.
items.explanationEn: in use /ɪn ˈjuːs/ (phrase): being used now. "Port already in use" means it is taken; opposite: unused.

items.question: Trong câu "Storage: long-term memory – stores files, the operating system, and software.", từ "long-term" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Storage: long-term memory – stores files, the operating system, and software.", what does "long-term" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: long-term /ˌlɒŋˈtɜːm/ (tính từ): dài hạn, lâu dài. "Long-term memory/storage" = bộ nhớ/lưu trữ dài hạn; trái nghĩa: short-term.
items.explanationEn: long-term /ˌlɒŋˈtɜːm/ (adjective): lasting a long time. "Long-term memory/storage" lasts; opposite: short-term.

items.question: Trong câu "OS: the foundational software – the bridge between hardware and applications.", từ "bridge" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "OS: the foundational software – the bridge between hardware and applications.", what does "bridge" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the top part of the nose
items.explanation: bridge /brɪdʒ/ (danh từ): cầu nối. Nghĩa bóng: "the bridge between A and B" = cầu nối giữa A và B.
items.explanationEn: bridge /brɪdʒ/ (noun): a link between two things. Figuratively, "the bridge between A and B" is what connects them.

items.question: Trong câu "Hardware + Software = a complete computer.", từ "complete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hardware + Software = a complete computer.", what does "complete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: complete /kəmˈpliːt/ (tính từ): hoàn chỉnh, đầy đủ. "A complete computer" = một máy tính hoàn chỉnh; động từ "complete" = hoàn thành.
items.explanationEn: complete /kəmˈpliːt/ (adjective): having all the needed parts. "A complete computer" has every part; the verb "complete" means to finish.
